features.name: Basic shapes
steps: Create a rectangle, a diamond, and an ellipse on an empty canvas, ensuring they do not overlap.
features.expected: The rectangle, diamond, and ellipse must all be created successfully without overlapping; the three types are correctly distinguishable.

features.name: Basic lines
steps: Create a straight line and a connecting line with an arrowhead.
features.expected: The straight line and the arrowed connector must be created correctly; the arrowhead style is displayed correctly.

features.name: Text
steps: Create the text Start, set a large font size, and change it to center alignment.
features.expected: The text Start must be created with the specified font size and center alignment; the style settings take effect.

features.name: Freehand drawing
steps: Draw a continuous curve with the freehand tool.
features.expected: Freehand drawing must produce one continuous curve; it must not break or skip points.

features.name: Moving elements
steps: Create three objects, then move the middle object below the other two.
features.expected: The three objects are created correctly; the middle object must be moved below the other two; the layer adjustment is correct.

features.name: Resize
steps: Create a rectangle, increase its width and reduce its height while keeping the object type unchanged.
features.expected: After increasing the rectangle's width and reducing its height the object type stays unchanged; the size changes are correctly reflected.

features.name: Multi-select
steps: Create four objects, select only three of them and move them together while the fourth stays in place.
features.expected: Only the three objects are selected and moved together; the fourth stays in its original position.

features.name: Lasso selection
steps: Use the lasso to select three objects spread across several positions and move them together.
features.expected: The lasso must accurately select the three objects spread across several positions; after moving, the positions are correct.

features.name: Stroke styling
steps: Create a rectangle and change its stroke color, stroke width, and border style.
features.expected: The stroke color, width, and border style must be applied correctly; other properties are unaffected.

features.name: Fill styling
steps: Create a rectangle, set a green background fill while keeping the dark stroke.
features.expected: The green fill takes effect while the dark stroke is kept; the fill and stroke do not override each other.

features.name: Roughness / line style
steps: Create two identical shapes, one with a smoother style and one with a clearly hand-drawn style.
features.expected: The two shapes have clearly distinguishable styles (smooth vs hand-drawn); the roughness setting takes effect.

features.name: Opacity
steps: Create two overlapping shapes and lower the upper shape's transparency so the lower one becomes visible.
features.expected: After lowering the transparency of the upper shape the lower shape becomes visible; the transparency setting is correct.

features.name: Rounded corners
steps: Create two rectangles, one with sharp corners and one with rounded corners.
features.expected: The two rectangles' corner settings are correctly distinguished (sharp / rounded).

features.name: Layer ordering
steps: Create three overlapping shapes and adjust the final layering with Bring forward / Send backward so the specified object is on top.
features.expected: After adjusting with Bring forward / Send backward the specified object is on top; the layer order is correct.

features.name: Duplicate
steps: Create one object, duplicate it twice, and arrange the three copies in a row.
features.expected: After duplicating twice there are three copies; they are arranged in a row with correct positions.

features.name: Delete + Undo
steps: Create three objects, delete one, restore it with Undo, and verify that its position and style are restored.
features.expected: Undo restores the deleted object; its position and style match the original state.

features.name: Arrow styling
steps: Create an arrow, set a curved path, change the arrowhead style, and modify the line width.
features.expected: The arrow's curved path, arrowhead style, and line width must be applied correctly.

features.name: Connector binding
steps: Create two rectangles and connect them with an arrow; after moving either rectangle the arrow remains connected to the corresponding object.
features.expected: The arrow must be correctly bound to the two rectangles; after moving either rectangle the arrow remains connected to the corresponding object.

features.name: Multi-step binding
steps: Create three nodes A, B, and C forming A
B
C; then swap the positions of B and C while keeping the connections correct.
features.expected: A → B → C connections are correct; after swapping the positions of B and C the connections remain correct.

features.name: Frame
steps: Create a frame and put text, a rectangle, and an arrow inside it.
features.expected: The frame must contain three elements—text, a rectangle, and an arrow—with correct ownership.

features.name: Frame movement
steps: Create a frame and three objects inside it; when the frame is moved, the inner elements must move with it.
features.expected: When the frame is moved its inner elements must move together; the relative positions are preserved.

features.name: Frame containment
steps: Create two frames, move an object from frame A into frame B, and verify that it finally belongs only to B.
features.expected: After an object is moved from frame A into frame B it belongs only to B; it cannot belong to two frames at once.

features.name: Mixed diagram
steps: Build a flow containing Input
Process
An Output flow diagram whose nodes use rectangles, diamonds, and ellipses respectively, correctly connected by arrows.
features.expected: The flow diagram's three node types are correct (rectangle / diamond / ellipse) and the arrows are connected correctly.

features.name: Complex styling
steps: Set different fill colors for the three flow nodes while unifying the stroke width, line style, and font.
features.expected: The three nodes have different fill colors but a uniform stroke width, line style, and font; the styling is applied consistently.

features.name: Search on canvas
steps: Create several text elements, only one of which contains Database, and locate it with "Find on canvas".
features.expected: "Find on canvas" must accurately locate the text element containing Database.

features.name: Zoom / pan
steps: Create two objects far apart and navigate from one to the other by zooming and panning without modifying the objects.
features.expected: Zooming and panning allows navigation to the other object; the objects themselves are not modified.

features.name: Theme
steps: Switch the editor to the dark theme and back to the light theme, ensuring the scene elements are not modified.
features.expected: Theme switching (dark / light) does not affect scene elements; element properties stay unchanged.

features.name: Canvas background
steps: Change the canvas background color and verify that existing elements' colors and properties do not change.
features.expected: After changing the canvas background color the existing elements' colors and properties stay unchanged.

features.name: Local image import
steps: Given the benchmark's local image fixture, insert the image into the canvas, scale it, and place it into the specified frame.
features.expected: The local image must be inserted into the canvas successfully; after scaling and placing it into the specified frame the ownership is correct.

features.name: Save / reopen
steps: Create a scene containing shapes, text, arrows, and a frame, save it as an Excalidraw file, then reopen it and verify that the structure and positions are essentially preserved.
features.expected: Save as an Excalidraw file and reopen it; the structure and positions are essentially preserved.

features.name: Export PNG
steps: Create the specified scene and export a PNG, verifying that the exported image contains all expected visible elements.
features.expected: The exported PNG must contain all expected visible elements; the image is complete.

features.name: Reset canvas
steps: After creating several elements, run "reset canvas" and verify the scene is cleared.
features.expected: After "reset canvas" the scene is cleared; no elements remain.

features.name: Bucket fill
steps: Create a closed shape and then use Bucket Fill to change the interior fill without altering other objects.
features.expected: Bucket Fill only changes the interior fill of a closed shape; other objects are unaffected.

features.name: Draw-to-shape
steps: Use freehand drawing to create an approximate geometric outline, then convert it into a standard geometric object via Draw to Shape.
features.expected: The freehand outline must be converted into a standard geometric object via Draw to Shape.

features.name: End-to-end diagram
steps: Build User
Login
Validate
A Dashboard / Error flow diagram containing 5 nodes, conditional branches, text, arrows, color differentiation, and an outer frame.
features.expected: The flow diagram must contain 5 nodes, conditional branches, text, arrows, color differentiation, and an outer frame; the structure is complete and correct.

features.name: End-to-end edit
steps: On the result of the previous task, move the Validate node to another position, add a Retry node, reconnect the flow, and ensure the original styling system stays unchanged.
features.expected: After moving the Validate node, adding a Retry node, and reconnecting them, the original styling system stays unchanged.

features.name: Persistence round trip
steps: Complete a scene with 8+ elements, save it, clear the canvas, reopen the file, export a PNG, and verify that the final scene structure is still correct.
features.expected: Save, clear the canvas, reopen, and then export PNG; the final scene structure is still correct.

features.name: Layer + frame + binding
steps: Create two frames, each containing several nodes; establish cross-frame arrow connections that remain correct in both connection and visual layering after changing node positions and layer order.
features.expected: Cross-frame arrow connections are correct; after changing node positions and layer order the connections and visual layering stay correct.
